views.what_it_constrains: Defines the side profile (X-Z plane) of the wedge. Shows a right-angled triangle with a vertical back edge (height) and a sloped top surface (ramp).
Defines the planar footprint (X-Y plane) of the wedge. Shows a rectangle, indicating the object has a uniform width (depth) and straight sides.

parts.name: Wedge Body
parts.description: A solid block with a rectangular base and a triangular side profile.

features.name: Ramp Surface
features.description: Inclined top surface sloping from the back (high) to the front (low).

features.name: Back Wall
features.description: Vertical face at the highest point of the wedge.

relations.description: Base and Back Wall meet at a 90-degree angle.

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: Exact height of the wedge is not explicitly dimensioned, inferred from the aspect ratio of the front view relative to the width.
Exact slope angle is inferred from the front view geometry.
generation_notes: The object is interpreted as a standard wedge. The front view provides the cross-section (triangle), and the top view provides the extrusion depth (rectangle). The 'lofted' description in the user prompt is interpreted here as a linear extrusion of the triangular profile, which is the standard geometry for a ramp.

parameters.note: Extrude the triangular profile along the Y-axis to match the rectangular footprint seen in the top view.

unresolved_constraints: Exact height of the wedge is not explicitly dimensioned, inferred from the aspect ratio of the front view relative to the width.
Exact slope angle is inferred from the front view geometry.

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
